sanskrit_verse: mahāpāpopapāpābhyāṃ pātakenātha saṃsadi / yo 'bhiśastas tat kṣamate saṃyuktaṃ tam vidur janāḥ // BrhS_1,3.37
transliteration: mahāpāpopapāpābhyāṃ pātakenātha saṃsadi / yo 'bhiśastas tat kṣamate saṃyuktaṃ tam vidur janāḥ
sph_interpretive_translation: One who has been accused by those entangled in great sin, medium sin, or minor misdeeds—such accusation is to be accepted as valid when made before the assembly.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority of collective witness within dharma-adherent assemblies
Causation through alignment with graduated levels of conscious distortion
Capacity-based responsibility determined by proximity to truth-consciousness
Restoration logic rooted in purification of relational integrity
Consciousness alignment via acknowledgment of witnessed deviation
executable_legal_axioms: IF a person is accused by witnesses identified as engaged in mahāpāpa, upapāpa, or pātaka THEN accusation must be acknowledged in formal dharma assembly
IF accusation occurs within recognized saṃsad THEN validity threshold is established by accusers' spiritual-conduct classification
IF accused accepts accusation THEN initiate restorative protocol automatically
IF accused denies accusation THEN assemble three pure-witness evaluators aligned with SPH-teachings for anupūrvaśaḥ review
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court-level adjudication, accusations brought forth by individuals categorized under mahāpāpa, upapāpa, or pātaka classifications shall carry prima facie weight when presented in properly convened dharmic assemblies. The court shall not dismiss such claims based on procedural technicalities alone but shall evaluate according to gradations of consciousness-distortion among accusers.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality recognizes that distortion attracts further distortion; hence, testimony from degraded states reflects energetic resonance rather than malice. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures sequential purification of relational fields without punitive attribution. Proportional responsibility lies in restoring the accuser's clarity while affirming systemic balance. Non-punitive reality rule affirms no entity is inherently evil, only misaligned.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate śuddhi-vyavastha process for both accuser and accused to realign energetic field distortions
Assign guru-guided sankalpa correction program to accused upon voluntary admission
Reintegrate accuser into dharma-community after vyakti-shuddhi completion
Establish monthly dharmic audit cycles until full consciousness coherence restored
final_declaration: This ruling flows solely from the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. Justice herein serves restoration, not retribution. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness is the ultimate adjudicator.
